name: lm-agent-vscode
description: VS Code chat tools and local bridge for LM Agent

languageModelTools.name: lm-agent-vscode_get_context
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read the active editor and selection.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the active VS Code editor's file path, language, text, and current selection. Use this when the user asks about the file currently open in the editor.

include_selection.description: Include the current selection when one exists.

languageModelTools.name: lm-agent-vscode_get_problems
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read errors, warnings, and other diagnostics currently shown in VS Code's Problems panel. Use this to investigate build or code issues.

languageModelTools.name: lm-agent-vscode_select_project_folder
languageModelTools.userDescription: Choose the project folder the agent can edit.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open a VS Code folder picker and set the project folder for LM Agent tools. Use before listing, opening, creating, or editing project files when the intended project is not already selected.

languageModelTools.name: lm-agent-vscode_select_analysis_folder
languageModelTools.userDescription: Choose a folder the agent may read for analysis.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open a VS Code folder picker and set a separate read-only analysis folder. Use when the user wants files analyzed without enabling edits in that folder.

languageModelTools.name: lm-agent-vscode_list_files
languageModelTools.userDescription: List files in the selected project or analysis folder.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List files and folders under the selected VS Code project or read-only analysis folder. Paths must be relative to the selected root; use scope 'analysis' only for read-only inspection.

path.description: Relative folder path; defaults to the selected root.

scope.description: Select the editable project root or read-only analysis root.

languageModelTools.name: lm-agent-vscode_read_file
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read a text file from the selected project or analysis folder.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read a text file by relative path from the selected project or read-only analysis folder. Do not use absolute paths.

path.description: File path relative to the selected root.

scope.description: Select the editable project root or read-only analysis root.

languageModelTools.name: lm-agent-vscode_open_file
languageModelTools.userDescription: Open a project file at a specific line in VS Code.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open a file from the selected project root in VS Code and optionally move the cursor to a line and column.

path.description: File path relative to the selected project root.

languageModelTools.name: lm-agent-vscode_create_file
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create a new file under the selected project folder.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a new text file in the selected project folder. Paths must be relative, remain inside the project, and the file must not already exist. Requires user confirmation.

path.description: New file path relative to the selected project root.

content.description: Complete text content for the new file.

languageModelTools.name: lm-agent-vscode_edit_file
languageModelTools.userDescription: Replace the contents of a file under the selected project folder.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Replace the complete text contents of an existing file in the selected project folder. Paths must be relative and remain inside the project. Requires user confirmation.

path.description: Existing file path relative to the selected project root.

content.description: Complete replacement content for the file.

languageModelTools.name: lm-agent-vscode_run_terminal
languageModelTools.displayName: LM Agent: Run VS Code Terminal Command
languageModelTools.userDescription: Send a command to a VS Code terminal rooted in the selected project.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Send a command to a VS Code terminal whose working directory is the selected project root. This tool does not read command output or verify its exit status. Requires user confirmation.

command.description: Command to send to the VS Code terminal.

lmAgent.bridgePort.description: Port for the local LM Agent bridge.

lmAgent.tokenFile.description: Path to the shared local bridge token file.

commands.title: LM Agent: Install Copilot Chat Agent
